title: Sensor or actuator?
instruction: Does it measure (sensor) or does it act (actuator)?

items.why: It measures temperature and reports a number.
It spins a wheel, so it acts.
It measures how loud a sound is.
It lights up and shows the output.
It measures how the device moves and tilts.
It reports whether someone pressed it. That is input too.
It shakes the phone, so it acts.

debrief: A sensor measures the world and gives the program input. An actuator changes the world and is the program’s output.
